shots.narration_dhivehi: އެއީ ދެހާސް އެގާރަވަނަ އަހަރު. ނޮވެމްބަރު މަހުގެ ރެއެއް. މާލޭގެ އުދަރެސް ބައްދާލާފަ އޮތީ ކަޅު ބޯ ވިލާތަކުން.
shots.narration_english: It was the year two thousand and eleven. A night in November. Malé's sky was wrapped in heavy black clouds.

shots.narration_dhivehi: މާލޭގެ ރާޅުގަނޑު ސަރަހައްދަށް ބިންދަމުންދާ ރާޅުތަކުން އިވެނީ ނޭނގޭ ބިރުވެރިކަމާ ނުރުހުމެއްގެ އަޑު. މާލޭގެ މަގުތަކުގަ ދުއްވާ އެއްޗެހި މަދު.
shots.narration_english: From the waves breaking on Malé's reef came a sound of nameless dread and unease. Few vehicles were moving on Malé's streets.

shots.narration_dhivehi: މުޅި މާލެ އޮތީ ބިރުވެރި ހިމޭންކަމެއްގެ ތެރޭގަ. އުމުރުން އަށެއްކަ އަހަރުގެ އިޔާން އިނީ އޭނާގެ ގޭގެ ސިޓިންގްރޫމްގެ ކުޑަދޮރު ކައިރީގަ.
shots.narration_english: All of Malé lay in a frightening silence. Eight-year-old Iyaan was sitting by the window of his home's sitting room.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާ އިނީ ބޭރަށް ބަލަހައްޓައިގެން ކޮންމެވެސް ހިޔާލެއްގެ ތެރެއަށް ގެއްލިފަ. އޭރު ބޯކޮށް ވާރޭ ވެހެން ފަށައިފި.
shots.narration_english: He sat looking outside, lost in some thought. By then heavy rain had begun to fall.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ވެހެމުން ދިޔަ ބޯ ވާރޭގެ ތިކިތައް ކުޑަދޮރުގެ ބިއްލޫރިގަނޑުގަ ޖެހި، ތިރިއަށް ފައިބަމުންދޭ. އިޔާންގެ ހިތުގަ އޮތީ އިންތިޒާރެއް.
shots.narration_english: The drops of the pouring rain struck the window glass and ran down. In Iyaan's heart there was only waiting —

shots.narration_dhivehi: އެއީ އޭނާގެ ބައްޕަ، ރައްޔިތުންގެ މަޖިލީހުގެ މެންބަރު އަހުމަދު ޒާހިރު ގެއަށް އަންނާނެ ވަގުތެއް. އަހުމަދު ޒާހިރަކީ ރައްޔިތުންގެ ލޯބި ލިބިފަ ހުރި، ތެދުވެރި ސިޔާސީވެރިއެއް.
shots.narration_english: for the moment his father, Member of Parliament Ahmed Zahir, would come home. Ahmed Zahir was an honest politician, loved by the people.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާގެ ދުލަކީ ކޮރަޕްޝަނާ އަނިޔާވެރިކަމާ ދެކޮޅަށް އަބަދުވެސް ބާރަށް އަޑުއުފުލަމުން ދިޔަ ދުލެއް. އެކަމުގެ އަގު ބައެއް ފަހަރު އޭނާ ދައްކަން ޖެހެނީ އަމިއްލަ ދިރިއުޅުމުގެ ރައްކާތެރިކަމުން.
shots.narration_english: His was a tongue that always spoke out loudly against corruption and oppression. Sometimes the price he had to pay for it was his own safety.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާގެ ދިރިއުޅުމަށް އެކި ކަހަލަ އިންޒާރުތައް ލިބެމުންދިޔަކަން އޭނާގެ އަންހެނުން، އާމިނަތަށް އެނގޭ. ސިޓިންގްރޫމްގެ ސޯފާގަ އިން އާމިނަތުގެ މޫނުމަތިން ފެންނަމުންދިޔައީ ނުތަނަވަސްކަން.
shots.narration_english: His wife Aminath knew he had been receiving all kinds of threats against his life. Unease showed on the face of Aminath, sitting on the sitting-room sofa.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާ ދެއަތް ދެއަތާ މޮޑެމުން، ގަޑިއަށް ބަލަމުން ދިޔަ. ގަޑިން ރޭގަނޑު އެގާރަ ޖަހަނީ. މަޖިލީހުގެ ކޮމިޓީ ޖަލްސާ ނިމޭނެ ކަމަށް ޒާހިރު ބުނި ވަގުތު ފަހަނައަޅައި ހިނގައްޖެ.
shots.narration_english: She kept wringing her hands and glancing at the clock. The clock was striking eleven at night. The time Zahir had said the parliament committee meeting would end had long passed.

beats.safe_substitution: mother and her own small son: a gentle hand on his hair, both fully clothed

shots.narration_dhivehi: މަންމާ، ބައްޕަ ކީއްވެތަ މާލަސްވަނީ؟ އިޔާން އަހާލި. އާމިނަތު ގަދަކަމުން ހިނިތުންވެލަމުން އިޔާންގެ ގާތަށް ޖެހިލި.
shots.narration_english: "Mamma, why is Bappa so late?" Iyaan asked. Aminath forced a smile and moved close to Iyaan,
shots.speaker: iyaan_young

shots.narration_dhivehi: އަދި އޭނާގެ ބޮލުގަ ފިރުމާލި. ދަރިފުޅާ، ބައްޕަ އެއުޅެނީ ގައުމީ ބޮޑު މަސައްކަތެއްގައެއްނު.
shots.narration_english: and stroked his hair. "My child, Bappa is busy with great national work, isn't he?
shots.speaker: aminath_young

shots.narration_dhivehi: ރައްޔިތުންގެ ހައްގުތައް ހޯދައިދޭން ބައްޕަ ވަރަށް ބުރަކޮށް އުޅެން ޖެހޭނެ. ދަރިފުޅު ދޭ ނިދަން.
shots.narration_english: To win the people their rights, Bappa has to work very hard. You go to sleep, my child.
shots.speaker: aminath_young

shots.narration_dhivehi: ބައްޕަ އައީމާ މަންމަ ގޮވާނަން. އިޔާން ނޫނެކޭ ބުނުމުގެ ގޮތުން ބޯ ހޫރާލި. ނޫން، ބައްޕަ ބުނި މިރޭ އަންނަމުން އަހަންނަށް ވާހަކަފޮތެއް ގެނެސްދޭނަމޭ.
shots.narration_english: When Bappa comes, Mamma will call you." Iyaan shook his head to say no. "No, Bappa said that when he comes tonight he'll bring me a storybook.
shots.speaker: iyaan_young

shots.narration_dhivehi: ބައްޕަ އައިމަ ދާނީ. އެ ވަގުތު ގޭގެ ބޭރުން ކާރެއް މަޑުކޮށްލި އަޑު އިވުނު. އިޔާންގެ މޫނު އުޖާލާވެގެން ދިޔަ. އެއީ ބައްޕަ!
shots.narration_english: I'll go when Bappa comes." Just then came the sound of a car stopping outside the house. Iyaan's face lit up. "That's Bappa!"
shots.speaker: iyaan_young

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާ އުފަލުން ހަޅޭއްލަވައިގަތް. އިޔާން ކުޑަދޮރުން ބޭރު ބަލާލިއިރު، އަހުމަދު ޒާހިރުގެ ކަޅު ކާރު ގޭގެ ދޮރުމައްޗަށް މަޑުކޮށްލައިފި.
shots.narration_english: he cried out with joy. When Iyaan looked out of the window, Ahmed Zahir's black car had stopped at the gate of the house.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ކާރުގެ ފަހަތު ސީޓުން ޒާހިރު ފޭބި. އޭނާގެ އަތުގަ ބޮޑު ބްރީފްކޭހެއް އޮތް. އޭނާ ކާރުގެ ޑްރައިވަރަށް ހިނިތުންވުމަކާ އެކު އަތް ހިއްލާލުމަށް ފަހު، ގޭގެ ދޮރާ ދިމާއަށް ހިނގައިގަތް.
shots.narration_english: Zahir got out of the back seat of the car. In his hand was a big briefcase. He smiled and raised a hand to the driver, then started walking toward the door of the house.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ބޯ ވާރޭގެ އަޑުގެ ތެރެއިން ކުއްލިއަކަށް ސައިކަލެއްގެ ބާރު އަޑު އިވުނު. ހެޑްލައިޓް ނިވާލައިގެން ދުއްވާފަ އައި އެ ސައިކަލުގަ ތިބީ ކަޅު ހެދުން އަޅައި، މޫނު ނިވާކޮށްގެން ތިބި ދެ މީހެއް.
shots.narration_english: Suddenly, through the sound of the heavy rain, came the loud roar of a motorbike. On that motorbike, which came racing with its headlight off, were two men dressed in black with their faces covered.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ސައިކަލު ގޮސް މަޑުކޮށްލީ ޒާހިރުގެ ކުރިމައްޗަށް. ކާރުގެ ޑްރައިވަރަށް އެ މަންޒަރު ފެނިގެން ކާރުން ފައިބަން އުޅުނު.
shots.narration_english: The motorbike stopped right in front of Zahir. The driver saw it and tried to get out of the car.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ނަމަވެސް ހުރިހާ ކަމެއް ހިނގީ ހީ ވެސް ނުކުރާހާ އަވަހަށް. ސައިކަލުގެ ފަހަތުގަ އިން މީހާ ދިގު ވަޅިއެއް ފާޑުގެ އެއްޗެއް ނެގި.
shots.narration_english: But everything happened faster than anyone could imagine. The man on the back of the motorbike pulled out something like a long blade.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ފުލުހުން ބައްޕަގެ މަރުގެ މައްސަލަ ނުނިންމި އޮތް މައްސަލައެއްގެ ގޮތުގަ ފައިލް ލައްޕާލި ދުވަސް އޭނާގެ ހަނދާނަށް އައި. އެއިރު އޭނާގެ އުމުރުން އެންމެ ބާރަ އަހަރު.
shots.narration_english: He remembered the day the police shelved his father's murder case as unsolved. He was only twelve years old then.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ޕޮލިސް ސްޓޭޝަނުން ނުކުމެގެން އައިއިރު، ގައުމުގެ އިންސާފުގެ ނިޒާމަށް އޭނާ ކުރި އިތުބާރު މުޅިން ގެއްލުނު.
shots.narration_english: When he walked out of the police station, he lost all the trust he had in the country's system of justice.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އެ ދުވަހު އޭނާ އަމިއްލަ ނަފްސަށް ވީ ވަޢުދަކީ، ކޮންމެވެސް އެއް ދުވަހަކުން އަދި އިންސާފު ހޯދާނެ ކަން. އެ ރޭ މަންމަ ނިދުމުން، އިޔާން އޭނާގެ ކޮޓަރިއަށް ވަދެ ދޮރު ތަޅުލި.
shots.narration_english: The promise he made to himself that day was that one day he would still find justice. That night, after his mother fell asleep, Iyaan went into his room and locked the door.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ކޮޓަރީގެ އެއް ފާރުގަ ހުރީ ބޮޑު ބޯޑެއް. އެ ބޯޑުގަ ހުރީ ބައްޕަ މަރުވި ރޭގެ ފޮޓޯތަކާ، އެއިރު މަޖިލީހުގަ ތިއްބެވި މެންބަރުންގެ ފޮޓޯތައް.
shots.narration_english: On one wall of the room was a big board. On that board were photos of the night his father was killed and photos of the members of parliament at the time.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އަދި އެކި މީހުންގެ މައުލޫމާތުތައް ރަތް ރޮދިން ގުޅުވާލެވިފަ. ބޯޑުގެ މެދުގަ ބޮޑު ސުވާލުމާކެއް ޖަހާފަ އޮތް.
shots.narration_english: And the information on various people was linked with red string. In the middle of the board was a big question mark.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އެއީ ބައްޕަ މަރާލަން އަމުރުކުރި އަސްލު މޭސްތިރިޔާއަކީ ކާކުކަން ނޭނގޭތީ. އިޔާން އޭނާގެ ލެޕްޓޮޕް ހުޅުވާލި.
shots.narration_english: That was because he did not know who the real mastermind who ordered his father's killing was. Iyaan opened his laptop.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާ ވަނީ ފުލުހުންގެ ސިއްރު ޑޭޓާބޭހުން ބައްޕަގެ މަރުގެ އިންވެސްޓިގޭޝަން ފައިލްތައް ހޯދާފަ. އެ ފައިލްތައް ކިޔަމުންދިޔައިރު އިޔާންއަށް ފާހަގަވީ އެއް ކަމެއް.
shots.narration_english: He had obtained the investigation files on his father's murder from the police's secret database. As he read through those files, Iyaan noticed one thing.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ބައެއް މުހިންމު ހެކިތަކާ، ބައްޕަގެ ފޯން ރެކޯޑިންތައް ވަނީ އެ ފައިލްތަކުން އުނިކޮށްފަ. މިއީ ސަރުކާރުގެ ވަރަށް މަތީ ފަންތީގެ ނުފޫޒެއް އޮވެގެން ނޫނީ ކުރެވޭނެ ކަމެއް ނޫން.
shots.narration_english: Some key evidence and his father's phone recordings had been removed from those files. This could not be done without very high-level influence in the government.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ކާކު؟ ކާކުގެ ނުފޫޒެއް؟ އިޔާން އަމިއްލަ ނަފްސާ ސުވާލުކުރަމުން ދިޔަ.
shots.narration_english: "Who? Whose influence?" Iyaan kept asking himself.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ހުރިހާ މަގުތަކެއް ބަންދުވަމުންދާ ކަހަލަ އިހުސާސެއް އޭނާއަށް ކުރެވުނު. ފާއިތުވި ފަނަރަ އަހަރު އޭނާ ކުރި މަސައްކަތުން ބައްޕަ މަރާލަން އައި މީހުގެ ސައިކަލު ދުއްވަން އިން މީހާ ދެނެގަނެވުނު.
shots.narration_english: He felt as if every road was closing in front of him. Through his work over the past fifteen years, he had identified the man who rode the motorbike that came to kill his father.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާ ފަހުން މަސްތުވާތަކެތީގެ އޯވަޑޯޒެއްގަ މަރުވެފަ އޮތް ކަމަށް އޮތީ ރިޕޯޓުކޮށްފަ. އޭނާ ލައްވާ އެކަން ކުރުވީ ކާކު ހެއްޔެވެ؟
shots.narration_english: He was later reported to have died of a drug overdose. Who made him do it?

shots.narration_dhivehi: އެ ސިއްރު ވަނީ ވަރަށް ފުންކޮށް ވަޅުލެވިފަ. ނުނިމޭ.
shots.narration_english: That secret lies buried very deep. To be continued.
